characters.summary: Bard is a skilled human archer and the captain of the Bowman of Esgaroth, renowned for his marksmanship and courage. He fights primarily at range using a great yew bow and the legendary Black Arrow, exploiting structural or anatomical vulnerabilities with precision.

techniques: Archery with a great yew bow

weaknesses: Vulnerable to normal human physical harm and fatigue
Limited supply of specialized ammunition like the Black Arrow
limitations: Ammunition limit, specifically relying on a single Black Arrow for hardened targets

sources.supports: Role as captain of archers, slaying of Smaug with the Black Arrow, and leadership of Lake-town survivors.

feats.claim: Slew the dragon Smaug with a single arrow shot to his unprotected spot on the chest.

notableResults.note: Guided by a thrush pointing out Smaug's bare spot, used the Black Arrow.

conditional.ability: Piercing impenetrable dragon scales with the Black Arrow
conditional.dependsOn: Using the Black Arrow and striking the bare patch on Smaug's breast

unknowns: Exact background details before becoming a captain of archers in Esgaroth.

characters.summary: Beleg Cúthalion, known as Strongbow, is a premier Elf archer and warrior of Doriath. He fights with his great bow Belthronding and the enchanted sword Anglachel, possessing exceptional woodcraft, tracking abilities, and martial prowess.

techniques: Melee combat with the iron sword Anglachel

weaknesses: Vulnerable to standard physical trauma despite Elven resilience
mobility: Foot movement with exceptional traversal speed through forests
limitations: Relies on physical weapons and ranged ammunition

sources.supports: Beleg's epithet Cúthalion, his weapon Belthronding, and his role in the Tale of Túrin Turambar.

feats.claim: Fought heroically in the wars of Beleriand against orcs and servants of Morgoth using bow and blade.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and destroyed multiple enemy bands in the wild.

campaignTags.claim: Exceptional woodcraft and stealth in the forests of Beleriand

unknowns: Full extent of Anglachel's inherent sentience or magical properties outside of being forged from meteorite iron.

characters.summary: Beorn is a formidable skin-changer who can assume the form of a massive, immensely strong black bear. In his human form he is a huge, bearded man wielding a great axe, and in battle he exhibits ferocious physical might and unstoppable rage.

techniques: Unarmed mauling and crushing in beast form
Great axe strikes in human form

mechanisms: Enormous thick hide and mass in bear form

weaknesses: Vulnerable to coordinated magical or physical overwhelm if caught unprepared
mobility: Foot movement with exceptional speed and endurance
limitations: Skin-changing depends on his emotional state and circadian rhythms or daylight constraints implied in lore

sources.supports: Beorn's skin-changing abilities, his immense size and strength, and his intervention at the Battle of the Five Armies.

feats.claim: Broke through goblin lines and killed Bolg during the Battle of the Five Armies.

notableResults.note: Fought as a giant bear, tearing through the bodyguard and crushing Bolg.

conditional.ability: Massive monstrous strength and bear physiology

campaignTags.claim: Massive stature even in human form and gigantic size as a bear

unknowns: Exact origin of his skin-changing lineage.

characters.summary: In his bear form, Beorn possesses the size and strength of a monstrous grizzly bear combined with human intelligence and relentless fury, capable of trampling armed warriors.

mechanisms: Impenetrable mass of thick fur and muscle

weaknesses: Restricted to melee range and raw physical combat
characters.formDifferences: Changes Beorn from a humanoid axe-wielder into a gigantic, immensely strong grizzly bear with enhanced melee power and durability.

sources.supports: Bear form capabilities, carrying bodies away, and tearing through goblin formations.

notableResults.note: Trampled and scattered the goblin guard effortlessly.

campaignTags.claim: Grows into a bear of colossal proportions

unknowns: Whether he can use tools or weapons while in bear form.

characters.summary: Beren is a mortal Edain hero of the First Age, famed for his unmatched tracking, woodcraft, and daring feats. He fights with sword and dagger, most notably cutting a Silmaril from Morgoth's iron crown.
weaknesses: Standard human mortality and vulnerability to physical injuries
limitations: Lacks superhuman physical durability or magical projection

sources.supports: Beren's quests, his title Erchamion (One-handed), and his retrieval of a Silmaril.

feats.claim: Cut a Silmaril from the iron crown of Morgoth inside Angband.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien

notableResults.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien
notableResults.note: Beren's hand containing the Silmaril was bitten off by the great wolf.

campaignTags.claim: Infiltrated Angband disguised in wolf and bat pelts

unknowns: Exact details of his survival in Dorthonion alone.

characters.summary: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit whose primary combat assets are stealth, cunning, and the One Ring. He avoids direct combat, using invisibility to evade enemies and occasionally using his small sword, Sting, against minor pests.

mechanisms: Small stature and silent hobbit feet

weaknesses: Physically frail with no combat training
Vulnerable when not wearing the Ring
limitations: Human-level physical strength and stamina; ring usage drains his vitality over time

sources.supports: Bilbo's possession of the One Ring, use of Sting, and exploits in Mirkwood.

feats.claim: Killed a giant spider in Mirkwood with Sting to rescue the dwarves.

notableResults.note: Used invisibility and Sting to rescue trapped dwarves.

campaignTags.claim: Becomes invisible when wearing the One Ring

unknowns: Full psychological corrupting weight of prolonged Ring ownership during his younger years.

characters.summary: Bolg is a massive Orc chieftain of Mount Gundabad, leading armies of goblins. He fights with a heavy scimitar and leads from the front with brutal physical dominance.

techniques: Heavy bludgeoning and slashing with scimitar

weaknesses: Prone to blind bloodlust and underestimating unconventional foes like Beorn
limitations: Relies on brute force and command structure

sources.supports: Bolg's role as son of Azog, commander of Gundabad orcs, and participant in the Battle of the Five Armies.

feats.claim: Led a vast army of goblins and wargs in the Battle of the Five Armies, slaying many foes.

notableResults.note: Crushed and torn apart by Beorn in bear form.

unknowns: Exact combat history prior to avenging Azog.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Boromir is a proud Prince and Captain of Minas Tirith, embodying the martial might of Gondor. He fights valiantly with a broadsword, a great shield, and the Great Horn of Gondor, relying on supreme physical conditioning and courage.

techniques: Blowing the Great Horn of Gondor to rally allies and terrify enemies

weaknesses: Vulnerable to ranged attacks such as multiple arrow wounds
Susceptible to the temptation of the One Ring
limitations: Human physical limits; cannot survive massive coordinated ranged fire

sources.supports: Boromir's role as Captain of the White Tower, his weapon loadout, and his last stand at Amon Hen.

feats.claim: Defended Merry and Pippin against a large band of Uruk-hai, slaying many before falling to multiple arrows.
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Breaking of the Fellowship

notableResults.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring, The Breaking of the Fellowship
notableResults.note: Fought heroically until mortally wounded by Lurtz's arrows while defending hobbits.

unknowns: Full extent of his leadership exploits during the defense of Osgiliath prior to Rivendell.

characters.summary: Carcharoth, the Red Maw, is the greatest of the wolf-hounds of Morgoth, bred to immense size and filled with insatiable fire and malice. He fights with devastating bite attacks and carries the burning agony of the Silmaril within his stomach.

mechanisms: Impenetrable demonic hide and massive physical bulk

weaknesses: Driven mad and tormented by the holy light of the Silmaril inside him
limitations: Prone to frenzied madness caused by the Silmaril

sources.supports: Carcharoth's origin as a wolf of Angband, biting off Beren's hand, and his rampage in Beleriand.

feats.claim: Bit off Beren's hand containing the Silmaril and survived the agonizing fire of the jewel.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien

notableResults.citation: The Silmarillion, Of Beren and Lúthien
notableResults.note: Overpowered Beren and severed his hand.

campaignTags.claim: Grown to monstrous proportions, the greatest wolf of the First Age

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability against divine intervention.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien Legendarium
characters.summary: Celeborn is a wise and ancient Elven lord of Lothlórien, fighting alongside Galadriel with mastery over Elven weaponry, statecraft, and protective warding magic.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to overwhelming physical force or dark magic if isolated
limitations: Bound by the waning power of the Eldar in Middle-earth

sources.supports: Celeborn's status as Lord of Lórien and husband of Galadriel.

feats.claim: Defended Lórien and led forces across the Anduin to sack Dol Guldur at the end of the Third Age.
feats.citation: The Return of the King, Appendix B

notableResults.citation: The Return of the King, Appendix B
notableResults.note: Successfully assaulted and dismantled the enemy stronghold with his hosts.

unknowns: His exact ancestral lineage and full exploits in the First and Second Ages.
